perfil: Donna, brimming with energy and optimism, is the heart and leader of Post Haste. Her arrows make short work of anything standing in the mail's way.

builds.d: A build that fires more and stronger arrows, significantly enhancing Auto Attacks.
A build that synergizes with doll attacks, improving ATK and skill synergy.

l.b: Extends the duration of Donna's ⟨Agile⟩ State. While ⟨Agile⟩ State is active, Auto Attacks accumulate water orbs which will all be fired to deal DMG after ⟨Agile⟩ State ends.
l.s: When the ⟨Advertising Doll⟩ disappears, extends the duration of ⟨Agile⟩ State by ⟦0⟧s. While ⟨Agile⟩ State is active, every 10 Auto Attacks generate 1 water orb, accumulating up to ⟦1⟧ orbs. When ⟨Agile⟩ State ends, the next Auto Attack fires all water orbs to pierce through the target, with each orb dealing ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Aqua Skill DMG.

l.b: While Donna is in ⟨Agile⟩ State, her Auto Attacks deal additional DMG.
l.s: While Donna is in ⟨Agile⟩ State, she fires ⟦0⟧ additional ice spikes with each Auto Attack, each spike dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Aqua Skill DMG.

l.b: While Donna is in ⟨Agile⟩ State, her Auto Attacks immediately defeat targets with low HP. She also deals increased DMG to elites and bosses with low HP.
l.s: While Donna is in ⟨Agile⟩ State, her Auto Attacks immediately defeat normal targets with HP below 35%. She also deals ⟦0⟧ more Skill DMG to elite or higher-tier targets with HP below 35%.

l.b: When Donna's Auto Attacks deal DMG while she is in ⟨Agile⟩ State, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken.
l.s: When Donna's Auto Attacks deal DMG while she is in ⟨Agile⟩ State, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 4s, stacking up to 25 times.

l.b: When Donna's Auto Attacks deal DMG to targets inflicted with ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩/⟨Chill⟩ while she is in ⟨Agile⟩ State, increases her ATK.
l.s: When Donna's Auto Attacks deal DMG to targets inflicted with ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩/⟨Chill⟩ while she is in ⟨Agile⟩ State, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 2s, stacking up to 36 times.

l.b: When Donna's Auto Attack hits a target near the ⟨Advertising Doll⟩, deals AoE DMG.
l.s: When Donna's Auto Attack hits a target near the ⟨Advertising Doll⟩, the doll unleashes waves, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Minion DMG.

l.b: Increases the Max HP of the ⟨Advertising Doll⟩. When the ⟨Advertising Doll⟩ disappears, deals AoE DMG over time.
l.s: Increases the Max HP of the ⟨Advertising Doll⟩ by ⟦0⟧. When the doll disappears, deals ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Minion DMG and creates a Bubble Pool that deals ⟦2⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Minion DMG every 0.5s for 4s. When the ⟨Advertising Doll⟩ is present, each of its attacks increases own Minion DMG by ⟦3⟧, stacking up to 7 times.

l.b: The ⟨Advertising Doll⟩ gains a shield. When the shield disappears, deals AoE DMG.
l.s: The ⟨Advertising Doll⟩ gains a shield equal to ⟦0⟧ of its base HP for 8s. When the shield disappears, the doll deals ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Minion DMG.

l.b: Increases the ⟨Advertising Doll⟩'s Attack Range and Minion DMG.
l.s: Increases the ⟨Advertising Doll⟩'s Attack Range by 50% and its Minion DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Donna or the ⟨Advertising Doll⟩ hits a target, heals the Doll and increases its Minion DMG.
l.s: When Donna or the ⟨Advertising Doll⟩ hits a target, restores 15% HP of the doll and increases its Minion DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 12s, up to 4 stacks. This effect can only be triggered once every 2s.

l.b: When Donna remains stationary, increases her ATK. Resets when she moves.
l.s: After Donna remains stationary for 1s, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧. Resets when she moves.

l.b: The Ultimate can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark⟩. Triggering this Mark increases own and the ⟨Advertising Doll⟩'s Aqua DMG.
l.s: Argent Cascade (Ultimate) can trigger ⟨Aqua Mark⟩. Triggering this Mark increases own and the ⟨Advertising Doll⟩'s Aqua DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 30s.

l.b: After casting the Main Skill, increases own Aqua DMG.
l.s: After casting Rain Call: Volley Chase (Main Skill), increases own Aqua DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 15s.

l.b: Increases the Ultimate's Attack Range and DMG.
l.s: Increases Argent Cascade (Ultimate)'s Attack Range by 50%. Increases Donna's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the ATK of Aqua Trekkers within the Attack Range of Argent Cascade (Ultimate).
l.s: Increases the ATK of Aqua Trekkers within the Attack Range of Argent Cascade (Ultimate) by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Each time the Ultimate hits a target inflicted with ⟨Freeze⟩/⟨Chill⟩, increases its duration and Ultimate DMG.
l.s: Each time Argent Cascade (Ultimate) hits a target inflicted with ⟨Freeze⟩/⟨Chill⟩, increases rain of arrows' duration by 1s and its Ultimate DMG dealt by ⟦0⟧. This effect can only be triggered 5 times.

builds.d: A build that concentrates attacks on targets in front.
A volley build that randomly attacks nearby targets.

l.b: The Support Skill fires additional Snow-Piercing Arrows to deal DMG based on the number of Aqua Trekkers in the squad.
l.s: Tide Threader (Support Skill) fires ⟦0⟧ additional Snow-Piercing Arrow with each shot for each Aqua Trekkers in the squad other than Donna, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Aqua Skill DMG.

l.b: When Snow-Piercing Arrow deals DMG, the arrow tail is left on the target. When the skill ends, pulls out the arrow tail to deal DMG.
l.s: When a Snow-Piercing Arrow deals DMG to Donna's target, 1 arrow tail is left on the target, up to ⟦0⟧. When Snow-Piercing Arrow deals DMG to a target with arrow tails, it deals ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Aqua Skill DMG. When Tide Threader (Support Skill) ends, pulls out all arrow tails to deal ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Aqua Skill DMG. Each arrow tail on the target increases this DMG by ⟦3⟧.

l.b: When Snow-Piercing Arrow deals multiple instances of DMG to Donna's target, deals additional DMG.
l.s: Increases Snow-Piercing Arrow's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧. Upon dealing 3 instances of DMG to Donna's target, deals an additional ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Aqua Skill DMG. This DMG can only be triggered once every 0.2s.

l.b: When Snow-Piercing Arrow deals multiple instances of DMG to Donna's target, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken.
l.s: When Snow-Piercing Arrow deals 3 instances of DMG to Donna's target, increases the target's Aqua DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 6s, stacking up to 9 times.

l.b: Snow-Piercing Arrow immediately defeats targets with low HP and deals increased DMG to elites and bosses with low HP.
l.s: Snow-Piercing Arrow immediately defeats normal targets with HP below 30%. Also, deals ⟦0⟧ more Skill DMG to elite or higher-tier targets with HP below 30%.

l.b: Increases Frost Wave's DMG and Attack Range. When the entire squad consists of Aqua Trekkers, the Support Skill generates more Frost Waves.
l.s: Increases Frost Wave's Attack Range by ⟦0⟧ and Skill DMG dealt by ⟦1⟧. When the entire squad consists of Aqua Trekkers, Tide Threader (Support Skill) generates 1 Frost Wave for every ⟦2⟧ shots fired.

l.b: Each time the Support Skill generates a Frost Wave, additionally creates Frost Wave Orbs that track the target and deal AoE DMG.
l.s: Each time Tide Threader (Support Skill) generates a Frost Wave, creates ⟦0⟧ Frost Wave Orbs that track the target. Upon hit, they deal ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Aqua Skill DMG. Frost Wave Orbs prioritize attacking different targets, with each distinct target increasing their Skill DMG dealt by ⟦2⟧.

l.b: Upon its first shot, the Support Skill creates a Frost Wave. Increases the Skill DMG dealt by Frost Wave.
l.s: Upon its first shot, Tide Threader (Support Skill) creates a Frost Wave. Increases the Skill DMG dealt by Frost Wave by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases Frost Wave's Crit Rate and DMG. When Frost Wave lands a Crit Hit, increases the ATK of Aqua Trekkers in the squad.
l.s: Increases Frost Wave's Crit Rate by 10% and Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧. When Frost Wave lands a Crit Hit, increases the ATK of Aqua Trekkers in the squad by ⟦1⟧ for 7s, stacking up to 4 times.

l.b: When Frost Wave deals DMG to different targets, increases own Aqua DMG.
l.s: When Frost Wave deals DMG to different targets, increases own Aqua DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 10s, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: Increases the ATK of Aqua Trekkers in the squad.
l.s: Increases the ATK of Aqua Trekkers in the squad by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When casting Tide Threader (Support Skill), delivers a letter near the main Aqua Trekker. When the main Trekker picks up the letter, increases their Aqua DMG.
l.s: When casting Tide Threader (Support Skill), delivers a letter near the main Aqua Trekker. When the main Trekker picks up the letter, increases their Aqua DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 12s.

l.b: The Ultimate can inflict ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩. While casting the Ultimate, when a Trekker triggers ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩, increases Donna's Aqua DMG.
l.s: When Argent Cascade (Ultimate) deals DMG, inflicts ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩. During the rain of arrows, when any Trekker triggers an ⟨Aqua Mark: Torrent⟩, increases Donna's Aqua DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 40s, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: Increases the Ultimate's Attack Range and DMG.
l.s: Increases Argent Cascade (Ultimate)'s Attack Range by 50%. Increases Donna's Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases the ATK of Aqua Trekkers within the Attack Range of Argent Cascade (Ultimate).
l.s: Increases the ATK of Aqua Trekkers within the Attack Range of Argent Cascade (Ultimate) by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Each time the Ultimate hits a target inflicted with ⟨Freeze⟩/⟨Chill⟩, increases its duration and Ultimate DMG.
l.s: Each time Argent Cascade (Ultimate) hits a target inflicted with ⟨Freeze⟩/⟨Chill⟩, increases rain of arrows' duration by 1s and its Ultimate DMG dealt by ⟦0⟧. This effect can only be triggered 5 times.
